drafts.angle: Every software factory needs a QC line (rides @garrytan 'you're really going to want your own software factory')
drafts.draft_en:
Every company is going to want its own software factory.

Every marketing team is going to want its own ad factory: a few people and a hundred agents shipping variants all day.

A factory without QC isn't a factory. It's a recall waiting to happen.

Aubric is the QC line for your ad factory. Every ad checked against brand rules, legal claims, and platform policy. Approve, fix, or block before a dollar of spend.
drafts.video_tip: 20s vertical: an assembly-line animation of ad cards sliding down a conveyor, each one passing under an Aubric scanner and getting stamped APPROVE, FIX, or BLOCK. Open on the text 'You're going to want your own ad factory' and close on 'Don't forget the QC line.'

drafts.angle: From chat speed to agent scale (rides @levie era-shift thesis)
drafts.draft_en:
AI output used to move at the speed you could chat with it.

Now you hand a brief to a set of agents and they come back with 500 ads.

Your creative output just went up 100x. Your brand, legal, and policy review team did not.

That gap is where the brand risk lives now. We built Aubric to close it: every ad reviewed in seconds, with the exact rule it broke and how to fix it.
drafts.video_tip: 30s talking-head. Hold up one finger for 'one ad, one reviewer', then cut to a screen showing a grid of 500 generated ads and a single reviewer avatar. Final 8 seconds: Aubric clearing the grid in a fast scroll with green, amber, and red tags.

drafts.angle: Re-test it and replicate it (rides @levie 'check back every 3 to 6 months' and @garrytan's public replication posts)
drafts.draft_en:
Two rules I'm stealing for AI in 2026:

1. Re-test what didn't work 6 months ago. The models moved.
2. Don't trust a claim until it replicates on your own data.

Apply both to ad review. If AI compliance checks missed things for you last spring, run your last 100 rejected ads through Aubric and see what it catches.

Replicate it yourself. That's the only benchmark that matters.
drafts.video_tip: Screen recording, 40s: drag a folder labeled 'rejected ads, last quarter' into Aubric, let the results populate live, and zoom into two flags with the exact rule cited. Caption: 'Replicate it yourself.' Replication posts earn bookmarks, so end on 'save this for your next audit.'
